summary: Backend-only retest of CURATED_HANDLES handle fixes. All 38 curated @handles now resolve to a channelId — up from 32/38 in iteration_16. Mongo caption_channel_cache contains exactly 38 documents, all with a non-null channel_id including the 6 previously-broken handles (Archdigest, bloomberglp, mkbhd, LateNightSeth, hollywoodreporter, businessinsider). /api/caption-search still functional: 'president' with refresh=true returned 1 curated-channel result (NBC News) — meets review's >=1 requirement; nonsense query returns 200 with empty results; result shape (video_id, title, channel_title, offset_seconds, has_timestamp, youtube_url, snippet) intact. Regression sanity on /api/auth/me passes — returns 200 with stripe_prices array populated (monthly + yearly). 8/8 pytest tests passed.

minor.issue: Only 1 curated-channel result even after all 38 handles resolved. Handle-fix delivered the intended 100% resolution rate, but the underlying broad-search coverage bottleneck from iteration_16 remains: YouTube global search.list rarely surfaces curated channels in top-50 for common terms. Consider pagination (2nd page of results = +100 quota, doubles surface area) or per-channel fallback for low-hit queries.

action_items: Handle-fix complete — no action required for this iteration's scope.

Optional follow-up (from iter_16 minor issue, not blocking): add pagination or per-channel fallback in caption_search.py to increase result count per query for common terms. Current expansion + fix gets 38/38 channels into the pool but broad-search still filters most out.
critical_code_review_comments: caption_search.py header comment on line 34-37 says 'focused on speakers with clear, natural General American English' — Vogue, Variety, GQ, VanityFair, Archdigest are magazine channels with mixed international guests. Fine for exposure but not strictly GA English. Documentation nit only.

The 6 renamed handles are correct on YouTube as of Jan 2026 — verified via cache resolution. However CURATED_HANDLES has no source-of-truth doc/comment; future YouTube handle renames will silently fail again (they resolve to 200 with items=[], not an error). Suggest a startup health-check log that warns if any curated handle fails to resolve, so ops can catch drift early.
